topic.description: What the post is about, in a sentence.

angle.description: The point of view or lesson to lead with.

cta.description: The call to action to end on, in Casey's words. When absent the post ends on a question.

confidential_terms.description: Names that must not appear, such as the client the lesson came from.

evidence_refs.description: Exact Business Brain or artifact references to the notes. Never a search.

notes.description: Notes passed inline, each with the reference it should be cited by.
